page_title: MON 0-0 UNI | B. Monchengladbach v Union Berlin 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) covers his face with his hands after spurning a great chance. The ball rebounded to him and his close-range header went a whisker wide of the right post.

90+4' Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
90+4' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+4' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
90+2' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) commits a rough challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for an infringement.

90+2' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Moritz Nicolas was alert and the score remained the same.
90+2' A lofted cross from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
88' A substitution has been made. Alassane Plea is replaced by Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach).
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kevin Volland departs the field of play to be replaced by Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin).
86' Here is a change. Josip Juranovic is going off and Nenad Bjelica gives the last tactical orders to Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin).
85' Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul after Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
84' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Sascha Stegemann saw the whole situation.
82' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
81' The resulting corner from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) comes to nothing.
81' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
80' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Robin Hack.
80' The referee signals a substitution. Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) is brought on as a substitute for Fabio Cristian Chiarodia.
78' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) jumps highest to win the header from the corner, but his close-range attempt is well blocked by a defender.
77' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) will take a corner kick.
77' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

76' Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) meets a cross from the wing well outside the box, steadies himself then fires in a projectile of a shot. He needed to be more precise to endanger the goalkeeper as his effort went inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) comes onto the pitch so that Brenden Aaronson can be given a rest.

74' CHANCE! Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
72' The ball is cleared after Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
71' Robin Knoche (Union Berlin) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
70' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
70' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
70' Some great controlled play and passing from Union Berlin. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
67' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
66' The manager makes a subsitution with Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) coming on for Tomas Cvancara.
66' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Stefan Lainer will be replaced by Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach).
65' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) takes the corner which is cleared.
65' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.

63' A great pass puts Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the right post. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
62' 8:8 – the total goal attempt statistics.

59' Frederik Ronnow pulls off a glorious save! Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to head home after a precise lofted cross. However, his effort only finds its way into the goalkeeper gloves.
59' B. Monchengladbach keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
57' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach).
56' The game is interrupted. Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
55' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Moritz Nicolas produces a wonderful reflex save.
54' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Sascha Stegemann who sees an offensive foul.

53' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) gets the ball from a rebound and thumps a terrific long-range shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, it sails narrowly wide of the left post. Unlucky finish. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
53' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
53' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

52' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Moritz Nicolas sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the top right corner.
51' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
48' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
48' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Moritz Nicolas intercepts the ball.
46' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) was quite harsh and Sascha Stegemann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' Nenad Bjelica makes a switch. Robin Knoche is coming on in place of Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) at the start of the second period.
46' The game is over for Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin). Andras Schafer comes on for the second half.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle. Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) commits a foul after dangerous play.

45' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) wastes a huge opportunity after receiving a fine cross from the free kick, but his close-range shot goes well over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
45' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) will take the free kick.
44' A yellow card is awarded to Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin).
42' The free kick from long range, taken by Union Berlin, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
41' Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Sascha Stegemann has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
40' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.

39' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Moritz Nicolas has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.

38' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
37' B. Monchengladbach string together a series of short passes.
37' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) makes a rough challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.

35' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Moritz Nicolas was alert and the score remains the same.
33' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
33' An attempted cross from Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared.
32' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
31' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
31' A cross from Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
29' The foul by Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) was seen by Sascha Stegemann who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
29' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:3.
27' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but Frederik Ronnow comes off his line to gather the ball.
25' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.

25' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) unleashes a great shot from long distance, forcing a beautiful save out of the keeper. His attempt went towards the top of the net, but Moritz Nicolas leapt like a salmon and punched the ball onto the bar and away.

23' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
21' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

20' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
19' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Frederik Ronnow makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
15' Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
14' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
12' Ball possession – 46:54.

8' A neat pass is well received by Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.

7' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
6' A spell of possession for Union Berlin in an attempt to control the game.
4' Sascha Stegemann has a clear sight and sees a foul from Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin).
3' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
